description: Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo and Swahili (add_international_text v1.7.0 on pdfnative 1.8): these languages are written in Latin with combining marks — Yoruba ẹ́ ọ̀, Igbo ị́ — which the bundled Noto Sans module now anchors (latin-marks shaper). `ha`, `yo`, `ig` and `sw` are ALIASES of `latin`: no extra font is loaded, the aliases de-duplicate against each other, and the bytes are those of `lang: 'latin'`. Decomposed (NFD) input is fine: text is NFC-normalised by default. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.

arguments.title: Four languages, one Latin module
paragraphs: Yorùbá — Ẹ káàárọ̀, ọ̀rẹ́ mi. Báwo ni?
Igbo — Ị́bọ̀ọ́lá chi, kedụ ka ị mere?
Hausa — Ina kwana? Ƙasar Hausa da ɗan Adam.
Kiswahili — Habari ya asubuhi, rafiki yangu.
